#+title: The ER diagram in projects/ores.sql/modeling/ores_schema.pum…
#+description: The ER diagram in projects/ores.sql/modeling/ores_schema.puml is regenerated by nothing and is far behind the SQL it describes. plantuml_er_generate.sh exists, is tracked, and rewrites the whole file from projects/ores.sql/create and drop, but no gate runs it and check_component_drift.py cannot see it: the ores.sql pass renders per-entity create scripts and neither reads nor writes this file. Regenerating it on 2026-09-28 produced 1127 changed lines that are not the timestamp, including an account table whose description is still the retired two-line summary and a column order that disagrees with the create script. The one-line change that prompted the run, dq_portfolios_artefact_tbl.is_virtual going from integer to boolean, was therefore hand-edited into the committed file rather than regenerated, which is the smell the drift gate exists to prevent. Two things want deciding together: whether the generator becomes a gate or the file is deleted as a duplicate of the create scripts, and who owns the drift it has already accumulated.
